directions.Mercury: Direction of the other planet receiving Mercury's aspect; if with Sun/Moon and lacking essential dignity, no direction

required_inputs: which natal planet(s) actually signify journeys in prior chapter
planet aspects and source essential dignity
planet-source conflicts weighted against alternate methods
limits: planetary chart glyph certainty pending scholarly verification for some lines
no dominance weight or deviation tolerance

required_inputs: historic triplicities and source sign mapping
limits: multiple significators can point to several different compass regions
no weighting or single best region without after-the-fact selection

required_inputs: Sun and Moon natal house quadrants
house-cusp calculations under specified historical chart geometry
limits: Lilly says Ptolemy diverges from other astrologers in these quarter predictions; original Ptolemy passage not collated
each class maps to 2 coarse compass regions, not one exact bearing
no dating, route, city or kilometers

required_inputs: Mars or Moon northern vs southern latitude
limits: not all planets and aspects eligible
one or both may have opposite latitude sign

source_methods.rule: Collect plurality or majority of positive directional testimonies from prior methods; no numeric weights, precedence or tie/failure handling given.
required_inputs: frozen set of eligible methods and indicators
tie-breaking and no-prediction rule fixed before labels revealed
limits: cannot select the method fitting known travel biography after the fact

directions.fire_or_earth: travel more by Land than Water
directions.water_or_air: Water, or sometimes Water sometimes Land

required_inputs: majority of originally selected travel significators
mutually defined element and historical animal/humane sign classes
limits: water/air branch itself allows multiple modes, not a precise prediction
horse/coach/foot historical vehicle era categories cannot be assumed modern ground transport codes
travel across land and water on same trip is common

directions.fixed_signs: long stay abroad and little profit

limits: mobility duration and economic outcomes are separate endpoints
fixed and movable different planets may conflict
no calibrated numbers or financial amount

precommitted_validation_requirements: define eligibility of planets/house/signs independent of observed travels
freeze exact house cusps and astronomical period rulebook
define whether trips, countries visited, longest stay or most frequent destination is target
define baseline bearing from source birthplace/country and category width
give travel-mode labels compatible with era and multi-modal trips
include conditional no-travel and no-direction output when indicators inconclusive
register all competing methods separately and a single preregistered combined method without post hoc selection
score on birth-record-confirmed untouched cohort with geography and mobility base-rate controls
keep no-match and missed journeys, and require actual outcome denominator
